AND IN THIS AGREEMENT ICG-Longbow Debt Investments No.4 S.A.R.L. and HSBC
Bank PLC shall together be referred to as "the Lender"
RECITALS
The Council is the local planning authority for the purposes of the 1990 Act for the area in
which the Site (as hereinafter defined) is situated.
Alpha is the owner of that part of the Site in fee simple in possession shown edged red on
Plan 2 to this Deed falling within title numbers GM737716, GM682673, GM524297 and
GM519502 ("Alpha Land"), which includes the Phase 1 Development Site.
The Council is the owner of part of the Site in fee simple in possession identified shaded
salmon on plan 1010/170 Rev.A attached to the Original Agreement at Schedule 2.
The Lender has an interest in the land owned by Alpha (including the Phase 1 Development
Site) by virtue of the Security.
On 14 September 2015 the Council granted the Outline Planning Permission (as hereinafter
defined).
The Developer submitted the Reserved Matters Application (as hereinafter defined) in
respect of the Phase 1 Development Site pursuant to the Outline Planning Permission to the
Council.
The parties to this Deed have agreed to enter into this Deed for the purpose of varying the
Original Agreement in respect of the land comprised in the Phase 1 Development Site (as
hereinafter defined) and in pursuance of section 106 and section 106A of the 1990 Act,
section 111 of the Local Government Act 1972, section 1 of the Localism Act 2011 and all
other powers so enabling.
This Deed is supplemental to the Original Agreement (as hereinafter defined).
The Council has agreed that the planning obligations as set out in the Original Agreement
may be varied as set out in this Deed in respect of the Phase 1 Development Site and the
Remainder of the Site (as hereinafter defined).
The Developer entered into a conditional contract to acquire the Phase 1 Development Site
from Alpha on 6 July 2017.
IT IS AGREED AS FOLLOWS

CONSTRUCTION OF THIS DEED
Where in this Deed reference is made to any clause, paragraph or schedule or recital such
reference (unless the context otherwise requires) is a reference to a clause, paragraph or
schedule or recital in this Deed.
Words importing the singular meaning where the context so admits include the plural
meaning and vice versa.
Words of the masculine gender include the feminine and neuter genders and words
denoting actual persons shall include companies, corporations and firms and all such words
shall be construed interchangeably in that manner.
Wherever there is more than one person named as a party and where more than one party
undertakes an obligation all their obligations can be enforced against all of them jointly and
against each individually unless there is an express provision otherwise.
Any reference to an Act of Parliament shall include modification, extension or re-enactment
of that Act for the time being in force and shall include all instruments, orders, plans
regulations, permissions and directions for the time being made, issued or given under that
Act or deriving validity from it.
References to any party to this Deed shall include the successors in title to that party and to
any deriving title through or under that party and in the case of the Council the successors to
its respective statutory functions.
LEGAL BASIS
This Deed is made pursuant to section 106 and Section 106A of the 1990 Act and section
111 of the Local Government Act 1972, section 1 of the Localism Act 2011 and all powers
so enabling.
The covenants, restrictions and requirements imposed upon Alpha under this Deed create
planning obligations pursuant to section 106 of the 1990 Act and are enforceable by the
Council as local planning authority against Alpha.
COMMENCEMENT DATE
The obligations in Schedule 3 shall come into effect on the date of this Deed:
Unless otherwise expressly stated the obligations contained in Schedule 1 do not come into
effect until the date on which the Development Commences by the carrying out on the
Phase 1 Development Site pursuant to the Reserved Matters Approval of a material
operation as specified in section 56(4) of the 1990 Act (subject to the provisions of clause
The Commencement Date will not be triggered by any of the following operations on any
part of the Phase 1 Development Site:
site investigations or surveys including exploratory boreholes or excavations;
site clearance;
site decontamination and associated earthworks;
the demolition of any buildings or structures on the Phase 1 Development Site;
the construction of temporary site access and service roads;
the erection of construction fencing or hoarding;
the erection of construction accommodation and facilities;
works for the decommissioning or provision of drainage or mains services to
prepare the Phase 1 Development Site for development;
works associated with ecological mitigation and/or the translocation of species;
and
the construction or works to the Rivington Chase access road serving the
Development pursuant to the Reserved Matters Approval.
THE ORIGINAL AGREEMENT
The parties hereto agree that save as varied in the manner referred to in clause 12 of this
Deed the Original Agreement shall continue in full force and effect in respect of the
Remainder of the Site and nothing in this Deed shall constitute a waiver of any subsisting
breaches of the Original Agreement occurring prior to the date of this Deed which shall
remain fully enforceable by the Council. For the avoidance of doubt:
The restrictions on commencement of development, other works and
occupation of dwellings triggers/ restrictions contained in the Original
Agreement shall continue to apply to any development or occupations carried
out on the Remainder of the Site where such land is bound by the Original
Agreement (for the avoidance of doubt these shall not be enforceable against
the Phase 1 Development Site in respect of Development carried out or
Dwellings Occupied under the Reserved Matters Approval); and
Any Dwellings Occupied on the Phase 1 Development Site pursuant to the
Reserved Matters Approval and/ or Outline Planning Permission shall continue
to be included and counted for the purposes of the Site wide Dwelling triggers
under the Original Agreement (for example those restriction on Occupation of
Dwelling triggers under paragraphs 5.1, 5.7, 7.2.1, 8.1 and 8.4 of the Original
Agreement) but not for the purposes of calculating the payments due under
paragraphs 6.1 (Health) and 7.1 (Primary Education) of Schedule 3 of the
Original Agreement in respect of the Remainder of the Site (for the avoidance
of doubt these shall not be enforceable against the Phase 1 Development Site
in respect of Development carried out or Dwellings Occupied under the
Reserved Matters Approval)
unless varied pursuant to a deed of variation or supplemental deed to which the
Council is a party
The obligations in Schedule 3 of this Deed are binding on Alpha's interests in the Remainder
of the Site and shall take effect on the date of this Deed, but all other obligations in this
Deed relate only to the Phase 1 Development Site and shall only take effect in accordance
with clause 6 of this Deed. Until Development is Commenced the Original Agreement shall
continue to apply to the Phase 1 Development Site.
CONDITIONALITY
This Deed is conditional upon and shall not take effect until the Development is Commenced
provided that clauses 3 to 11, 13 to 18 and the obligations in Schedule 3 shall come into
effect immediately upon completion of this Deed (together with all clauses and paragraphs
required to give effect to such provisions).
COVENANTS BY ALPHA
Alpha covenants with the Council to comply with the obligations set out in Schedule 1 and
Schedule 3 in relation to the Development.
THE COUNCIL'S COVENANTS
The Council covenants with Alpha to comply with the obligations set out in Schedule 2.
THE LENDER'S CONSENT
The Lender acknowledges and declares that this Deed has been entered into by Alpha with
its consent and that the Alpha Land shall be bound by the obligations contained in this Deed
and that the Security shall take effect subject to this Deed PROVIDED THAT the parties
agree that no obligation in this Agreement shall be enforceable against the Lender or any
receiver or administrator appointed by the Lender and they shall have no liability under this
Deed unless and until the Lender, receiver or administrator has entered into possession of
the Alpha Land or any part thereof (including the Phase 1 Development Site) to which such
obligation relates.
THE DEVELOPER'S CONSENT
The Developer enters into this Deed for the purpose of consenting to the Developer's
interest in the Phase 1 Development Site being bound by this Deed but it shall only be
bound by the terms of this Deed in respect of the Phase 1 Development Site or any part
thereof) in the event that the Developer becomes a successor in title to Alpha
MISCELLANEOUS
No provisions of this Deed shall be enforceable under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
This Deed shall be registrable as a local land charge by the Council.
Where the agreement, approval, consent or expression of satisfaction is required by Alpha
or the Developer from the Council under the terms of this Deed such agreement, approval or
consent or expression of satisfaction shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed and any
such agreement, consent, approval or expression of satisfaction shall be given on behalf of
the Council by the Director of Place and any notices shall be deemed to have been properly
served if sent by recorded delivery to the principal address or registered office (as
appropriate) of the relevant party.
Following the performance and satisfaction of all the obligations contained in this Deed the
Council shall forthwith effect the cancellation of all entries made in the Register of Local
Land Charges in respect of this Deed.
Insofar as any clause or clauses of this Deed are found (for whatever reason) to be invalid
illegal or unenforceable then such invalidity illegality or unenforceability shall not affect the
validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions of this Deed.
This Deed shall cease to have effect (insofar only as it has not already been complied with)
if the Reserved Matters Approval shall be quashed, or if the Outline Planning Permission or
the Reserved Matters Approval shall be revoked or otherwise withdrawn or (without the
consent of Alpha) the Reserved Matters Approval is modified by any statutory procedure or
expires prior to the Commencement of the Development.
No person shall be liable for any breach of any of the planning obligations or other
provisions of this Deed after it shall have parted with its interest in the Phase 1 Development
Site or any part thereof but without prejudice to liability for any subsisting breach arising
prior to parting with such interest PROVIDED THAT the obligations in Schedule 3 of this
Deed shall continue to bind Alpha and Alpha's interests in the Remainder of the Site after
Alpha has parted with its interest in the Phase 1 Development Site.
Nothing in this Deed shall prohibit or limit the right to develop any part of the Phase 1
Development Site in accordance with a planning permission granted (whether or not on
appeal) after the date of this Deed nor shall any payment be due to the Council pursuant to
the Original Agreement or this Deed as a result of any development carried out pursuant to
such later planning permission.
This Deed shall not be enforceable against any statutory undertaker who has acquired any
part of the Site on which its apparatus is situated subject to this immunity from enforcement
only applying in respect of the land in the ownership of the statutory undertaker and only for
the time the land is in the ownership of the statutory undertaker and has apparatus on or in it
and only if the land is not used for any other purpose whatsoever besides the
accommodation of the statutory undertaker's apparatus
None of the covenants or obligations contained in this Deed shall bind or be enforceable
against any owner or occupier (or their mortgagees/chargees) of any Dwelling to be
constructed on the Phase 1 Development Site nor against those deriving title from them.
VARIATION TO ORIGINAL AGREEMENT
Following the Commencement Date, the parties hereto agree that the Original Agreement
shall be varied and deemed to be varied as follows:
the planning obligations as set out in paragraphs 1 (Open Space), 2 (Creation
of New Habitats), 3 (Off-Site Highways Works), 4 (Travel Plan), 5 (Affordable
Housing), 6 (Health Contributions), 7 (Education Contributions), 8 (Public
Transport Provisions), 9 (Heritage Core) and 10 (Off-Site Ecological
Enhancement) of Schedule 3 of the Original Agreement shall no longer apply to
the Development carried out and Occupations under the Reserved Matters
Approval in respect of the Phase 1 Development Site and shall no longer be
enforceable by the Council against the Reserved Matters Approval for the
Phase 1 Development Site. For the avoidance of doubt, the provisions of those
paragraphs shall continue to apply to the Remainder of the Site in accordance
with clauses 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 of this Deed, unless varied pursuant to a separate
deed entered into with the Council;
the Primary Education Contribution provisions as set out at Part 1 of Schedule
1 of this Deed shall apply to the Development under the Reserved Matters
Approval for the Phase 1 Development Site in lieu of paragraph 7 of Schedule
3 of the Original Agreement (Education Contributions). For the avoidance of
doubt paragraph 7 of Schedule 3 of the Original Agreement shall continue to
apply to the Remainder of the Site; and
the Health Contribution provisions as set out at Part 2 of Schedule 1 of this
Deed shall apply to the Development under the Reserved Matters Approval for
the Phase 1 Development Site in lieu of paragraph 6 of Schedule 3 of the
Original Agreement (Health Contribution). For the avoidance of doubt
paragraph 6 of Schedule 3 of the Original Agreement shall continue to apply to
the Remainder of the Site.
AND IT IS FURTHER AGREED THAT following the Commencement Date:
For the avoidance of doubt the Developer will have no liability or responsibility whatsoever in
relation to the planning obligations contained in the Original Agreement insofar as those
planning obligations relate to and/or bind the Remainder of the Site and/or any other land
PROVIDED THAT the Developer has no interest in the Remainder of the Site and/ or such
other land and that Development of the Phase 1 Development Site is carried out pursuant to
the Reserved Matters Approval.
Subject to the provisions of Clauses 5.1 and 5.2 of this Deed, the Original Agreement shall
not be enforceable against Alpha in respect of the Development carried out pursuant to the
Reserved Matters Approval for the Phase 1 Development Site or any person deriving title
from it in respect of the Phase 1 Development Site nor against any other person owning any
estate or interest or otherwise occupying the Phase 1 Development Site or any part thereof
from time to time accordingly.
The Developer or any person deriving title from it or any other person owning any estate or
interest or otherwise occupying the Phase 1 Development Site or any part thereof shall not
be liable to pay any sum or sums pursuant to the Original Agreement in respect of the
Development pursuant to the Reserved Matters Approval.
No restriction upon the development or use of land in the Original Agreement shall be
enforceable against Alpha in respect of the Development pursuant to the Reserved Matters
Approval on the Phase 1 Development Site or any person deriving title from it nor against
any other person owning any estate or interest or otherwise occupying the Phase 1
Development Site or any part thereof from time to time.
No requirement in the Original Agreement that specified operations, activities or uses of land
should be carried out shall be enforceable against Alpha in relation to the Development
carried out under the Reserved Matters Approval in respect of its interest in the Phase 1
Development Site or any person deriving title from it nor against any other person owning
any estate or interest or otherwise occupying the Phase 1 Development Site or any part
thereof from time to time.
Notwithstanding any Development Rights neither the Developer nor any person deriving title
from it in respect of the Phase 1 Development Site nor any other person owning any estate
or interest or otherwise occupying the Phase 1 Development Site or any part thereof from
time to time shall have any liability or responsibility whatsoever in relation to the planning
obligations or any other obligations in the Original Agreement insofar as those planning or
other obligations relate to and/or bind the Remainder of the Site PROVIDED THAT for the
avoidance of doubt where any person has a land interest in the Remainder of the Site other
than Development Rights which is capable of being bound by the Original Agreement then
such land interest in the Remainder of the Site shall be so bound by the Original Agreement
in the usual way.
DETERMINATION OF DISPUTES
Subject to clause 13.7 if any dispute arises relating to or arising out of the terms of this
Deed, any party may give to the others written notice requiring the dispute to be determined
under this clause 13. The notice is to propose an appropriate Specialist and specify the
nature and substance of the dispute and the relief sought in relation to the dispute.
For the purposes of this clause 13 a "Specialist" is a person qualified to act as an expert in
relation to the dispute and unless otherwise agreed in writing by Alpha and the Council
having not less than ten years' professional experience in relation to developments in the
nature of the Development and preferably property on the North West of England or if no
such person can be found within the North West of England then such other person as may
be found within England or Wales.
Any dispute over the type of Specialist appropriate to resolve the dispute may be referred at
the request of any party to the President or next most senior available officer of the Law
Society who will have the power, with the right to take such further advice as he may
require, to determine the appropriate type of Specialist and to arrange his nomination under
clause 13.4.
Any dispute over the identity of the Specialist is to be referred at the request of any party to
the President or other most senior available officer of the organisation generally recognised
as being responsible for the relevant type of Specialist who will have the power, with the
right to take further advice as he may require, to determine and nominate the appropriate
Specialist or to arrange his nomination. If no such organisation exists, or the parties cannot
agree the identity of the organisation, then the Specialist is to be nominated by the President
or next most senior available officer of the Law Society.
The Specialist is to act as an independent expert and :
each party may make written representations within ten working days of his
appointment and will copy the written representations to the other party or
parties;
each party is to have a further ten working days to make wrtten comments on
the other's representations and will copy the written comments to the other
party of parties;
the Specialist is to be at liberty to call for such written evidence from the parties
and to seek such legal or other expert assistance as he or she may reasonably
require;
the Specialist is not to take oral representations from the parties without giving
all relevant parties the opportunity to be present and to give evidence and to
cross-examine each other;
the Specialist is to have regard to all representations and evidence before him
when making his decision, which is to be in writing, and is to give reasons for
his decision; and
the Specialist is to use all reasonable endeavours to publish his decision within
30 working days of his appointment.
Responsibility for the costs of referring a dispute to a Specialist under this clause 13,
including costs connected with the appointment of the Specialist and the Specialist's own
costs, but not the legal and other professional costs of any party in relation to a dispute, will
be decided by the Specialist.
This clause 13 does not apply to disputes in relation to matters of law or the construction or
interpretation of the Deed which wil be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts.
WAIVER
No waiver (whether expressed or implied) by the Council (or Alpha or the Developer) of any
breach or default in performing or observing any of the covenants terms or conditions of this
Deed shall constitute a continuing waiver and no such waiver shall prevent the Council (or
Alpha or the Developer) from enforcing any of the relevant terms or conditions or for acting
upon any subsequent breach or default.
VALUE ADDED TAX
Subject to clause 15.2 below, all consideration given in accordance with the terms of this
Deed shall be exclusive of any VAT properly chargeable in respect of the supply for which
the consideration is provided and such VAT shall (subject to receipt of a valid VAT invoice)
be payable in addition to such consideration by the recipient of the supply
Alpha, the Developer and the Council hereby acknowledge and agree that no VAT is
considered payable and:
in accordance with the guidance provided by HM Revenue & Customs
("HMRC") in paragraph 8 of Notice 742:
the payment of money by Alpha and/or the Developer pursuant to the
provisions of this agreement does not represent consideration for any
supply made by the Council to Alpha and/or the Developer for the
purposes of VAT; and
the provision of goods and services by the Alpha and/or the Developer to
the Council pursuant to the provisions of this agreement for no, or merely
nominal, consideration is not a supply for a consideration for the
purposes of VAT;
15.2.2 if, at any time, HMRC determines in writing (after full disclosure of all material
facts) that a supply has arisen for VAT purposes, the supplier of that supply shall issue a
valid VAT invoice to the recipient of the supply (together with a copy of such HMRC
determination) and the recipient shall within 3q days pay an amount equal to such VAT to
the supplier.

DELIVERY
The provisions of this Deed (other than this clause which shall be of immediate effect) shall
be of no effect until this Deed has been dated.
INDEXATION
Any sum payable under this Deed shall be increased by an amount equivalent to the
increase in the Index from:
in the case of the Off-Site Highways Contribution and the Green Land Management
Contribution from the date of this Deed to the date upon which the relevant sum is paid
in the case of other payments in Schedule 1 from the date of the Original Agreement to the
date upon which the relevant sum is paid
In witness whereof the parties hereto have executed this Deed on the day and year first before
written.
Schedule 1
Part 1 - Primary Education Contribution
Alpha shall pay to the Council the Primary Education Contribution in respect of the Market
Dwellings comprised in the Development in the following manner:
within 5 Working Days of each anniversary of this Deed until all Market Dwellings in the
Development have been Completed and first Occupied Alpha shall provide written notice to
the Council setting out the number of Market Dwellings that have been Completed and first
Occupied on the Phase 1 Development Site during the preceding 12 month period;
within 4 weeks of each anniversary of this Deed Alpha shall pay to the Council the Primary
Education Contribution for the preceding 12 month period calculated on the basis of the
number of Market Dwellings Completed and first Occupied on the Phase 1 Development
Site during that period; and
prior to Occupation of the final Dwelling a reconciliation calculation shall be performed and
Alpha shall pay all contributions and outstanding amounts due in respect of the Primary
Education Contribution
Part 2 - Health Contribution
Alpha shall pay to the Council the Health Contribution in respect of the Market Dwellings
comprised in the Development in the following manner:
within 5 Working Days of each anniversary of this Deed until all Market Dwellings in the
Development have been Completed and first Occupied Alpha shall provide written notice to
the Council setting out the number of Market Dwellings that have been Completed and first
Occupied on the Phase 1 Development Site during the preceding 12 month period;
within 4 weeks of each anniversary of this Deed Alpha shall pay to the Council the Health
Contribution for the preceding 12 month period calculated on the basis of the number of
Market Dwellings Completed and first Occupied on the Phase 1 Development Site during
that period; and
prior to Occupation of the final Dwelling a reconciliation calculation shall be performed and
Alpha shall pay all contributions and outstanding amounts due in respect of the Health
Contribution
Part 3 - Off-site Highways Contribution
Alpha shall pay to the Council the Off-site Highways Contribution in respect of the Market
Dwellings comprised in the Development in the following manner:
within 5 Working Days of each anniversary of this Deed until all Market Dwellings in the
Development have been Completed and first Occupied Alpha shall provide written notice to
the Council setting out the number of Market Dwellings that have been Completed and first

Part 1 - Alpha Land Viability Assessment
For the purposes of Part 1 and Part 2 of this Schedule only Alpha shall mean Alpha

binding upon all land interests of Alpha within the Remainder of the Site
A viability assessment dated October 2017 prepared by Keppie Massie was submitted in

currently be achieved and that there is projected to be a deficit in viability terms on
completion of development of the Alpha Land as a whole, having regard to:
the land cost for the Alpha Land of £12,460,000 (included in the template at Schedule 8 to
the Original Agreement);
the net land receipt by Alpha in respect of the Phase 1 Development Site and other receipts
included in the viability assessment;
minimum profit of 25% of gross development value for the Alpha Land; and
the residual land value on the remainder of the Alpha Land, using estimated costs and
estimated house sale receipts relating to developing the remainder of the Alpha Land.
No future reserved matters applications shall be submitted pursuant to the Outline Planning
Permission in respect of any other part of the Alpha Land in the Remainder of the Site,
unless at the same time an updated viability assessment is submitted to the Council for
approval prepared on an open book basis and by a suitably qualified chartered surveyor,
such assessment to:
assess the viability of the Alpha Land as a whole, including all land receipts in respect of the
Alpha Land (including the Phase 1 Development Site) and all other sources of income or
expected receipts;
where a new land receipt is included, to be accompanied by reasonable evidence
demonstrating that the relevant land has been competitively tendered;
include up to date projected cost and sales information for the residual land calculation for
the remainder of the Alpha Land, informed by actual costs where possible;
otherwise be prepared in accordance with the template at Schedule 8 to the Original
Agreement (as may be varied) and broadly following the methodology used for the October
2017 viability assessment report prepared by Keppie Massie (or as otherwise agreed with
the Council).
be accompanied by appropriate supporting information and evidence, including receipts,
invoices, estimates and other material that the Council may reasonably require; and
conclude as to whether an Acceptable Return will be achieved and the level of Affordable
Housing and level of other contributions which can be viably provided within the relevant
reserved matters area whilst achieving an Acceptable Return.

viability assessment has been submitted and approved by the Council in accordance with
the provisions above.

upon all land owned by Alpha in the Remainder of the Site
